# Commonwealth Migration Canada

> Commonwealth Migration Canada is a Brampton, Ontario-based Canadian immigration consultancy serving clients across Canada. The website provides general immigration information, practical tools, and consultation pathways. Official IRCC, provincial, regulator, IRB, and Federal Court sources control where requirements or dates change.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/): Licensed RCIC immigration consulting services for Canada.
- [Free Canada immigration assessment](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/assessment/free-canada-immigration-assessment): A starting point for identifying possible pathways and preparation needs.
- [Book an immigration consultation](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/contact/book-immigration-consultation-canada): Consultation request page for file-specific guidance.
- [Canada immigration calculators](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/tools/canada-immigration-calculators): Free planning tools and eligibility calculators.
- [Immigration draws](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/immigration-draws): Draw information and planning context.

## Permanent residence and immigration pathways

- [Express Entry](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/immigrate/express-entry): Federal Express Entry pathway information.
- [Provincial Nominee Programs](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/immigrate/provincial-nominee-program-all-provinces-consolidated): PNP overview and province-specific pathways.
- [Federal Skilled Worker](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/immigrate/federal-skilled-worker): FSW eligibility and preparation information.
- [Canadian Experience Class](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/immigrate/canadian-experience-class): CEC pathway information for qualifying Canadian experience.
- [Family sponsorship](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/sponsor/family-sponsorship-overview-all-categories): Sponsorship categories and preparation guidance.
- [Canadian citizenship](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/citizenship/adult-grant-of-citizenship): Citizenship pathway information.

## Temporary residence, work, and study

- [Canada work permits](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/work-and-study/canada-work-permit-overview): Work permit pathway information.
- [Canada study permits](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/work-and-study/canada-study-permit): Study permit planning information.
- [Post-Graduation Work Permit](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/work-and-study/post-graduation-work-permit-pgwp): PGWP information and preparation context.
- [Visitor visa and Super Visa](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/visit/visitor-visa-trv-and-super-visa-combined): Visitor and Super Visa information.

## Inadmissibility and appeals

- [Criminal inadmissibility](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/inadmissibility-and-appeals/criminal-inadmissibility-overview): Information about criminal inadmissibility options.
- [Refusal and procedural fairness response](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/inadmissibility-and-appeals/refusal-and-pfl-response): General information about refusals and PFL responses.
- [Judicial review](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/inadmissibility-and-appeals/judicial-review-federal-court): Federal Court judicial review information.

## About and sources

- [About Commonwealth Migration](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/about/about-commonwealth-migration): Organization and service information.
- [Blog and Canada immigration guides](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/blog): Educational immigration content.
- [Privacy policy](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/legal/privacy-policy): Privacy information.
- [Terms of service](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/legal/terms-of-service): Terms information.
- [Disclaimer](https://commonwealthmigration.ca/legal/canada-immigration-disclaimer): General-information and responsibility disclaimer.
